preamble: Reduction of the open-mid front vowel [ɛ] to schwa [ə] in unstressed syllables. In English, a stressed /ɛ/ surfaces as [ə] when a derivational suffix moves the stress (telegraph ~ telegraphy, celebrate ~ celebrity, melody ~ melodious). In Eastern Catalan, unstressed /a/, /e/ and /ɛ/ all neutralize to [ə], so stem /ɛ/ reduces whenever stress falls elsewhere (terra ~ terreny, pèl ~ pelut).

examples.note: The stressed first-syllable /ɛ/ reduces to [ə] when stress moves to the second syllable.
Same reduction of the initial /ɛ/ under stress shift; RP has [ɪ] in this word.
Initial /ɛ/ reduces to [ə] once stress moves to the following syllable.
